# BTicino C300X Integration v1.4.3

This is a maintenance release for v1.4.2. It keeps the same consolidated C300X
Doorstation card, mobile Ring Call blueprints and display/dashboard behavior.

## Highlights

- Uses the consolidated C300X Doorstation card for generated Lovelace
  dashboards.
- Adds Android and iOS Ring Call blueprints with Answer, Hang Up and dashboard
  actions.
- Reduces C300X display dashboard load while pages are hidden or the display is
  idle.
- Improves on-demand video startup after Home Assistant restarts and after Home
  Calls.
- Keeps on-demand stop/hangup from briefly reporting an external media session.
- Restores the standard Home Assistant name picker in the card editor,
  including composed names in localized frontends.
- Stabilizes the first doorstation stream start after Home Assistant restarts.
- Keeps the card state correct after calls end.
- Refreshes old generated C300X dashboard cards when the one-time Lovelace card
  Repair runs.

## Upgrade Notes

- Breaking change from v1.4.2: generated dashboards use the consolidated C300X
  Doorstation/Home Call card. Run the one-time Lovelace card Repair or replace
  older manual split-card YAML with the consolidated card configuration.
- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- The packaged native C300X device agent bundle is unchanged from v1.4.1/v1.4.2.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant if it is older than
  `1.4.1`.
- Run the one-time Lovelace card Repair if Home Assistant offers it.
- Hard-reload the browser or clear the Home Assistant app/WebView cache if a
  dashboard still shows old card behavior.
